snip.t: Coronary angiography - usually performed when coronary artery bypass graft surgery or percutaneous coronary intervention is being considered.

Percutaneous Coronary Intervention- involves passing a guidewire across a coronary stenosis under radiographic control, and using it to position a balloon that is then inflated to dilate the stenosis.
Percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI): A catheter is used to mechanically open the blocked artery, often with stent placement.
STEMI: Primary Percutaneous Coronary Intervention (PCI) — Intravenous fibrinolysis
